thread:
alex_support: Hey team — escalation from a customer after ALB cutover. Their SSE streams consistently stop after ~60s, client sees a partial last event and then reconnects which duplicates the tail. They call it 'half-closed stream' behavior. Reported after we moved them behind ALB + nginx-ingress.
chris_netops: Can you paste client error / logs? ALB default idle timeout is 60s so this smells like idle timeout + buffering.

ajex_support: copying what customer sent: 

jess_support-liaison: "Client error: 'ERR_INCOMPLETE_CHUNKED_ENCODING' in browser console. Network tab shows last event truncated, then connection closed. Reconnect happens immediately and they get repeated last token. Happens ~60s after stream start every time."

alex_dev: Do we have the raw request/response headers and a tcpdump? Also which upstream is doing the SSE (node/express, go)? They said node.js.

jess_support-liaison: They provided a minimal reproducer curl command: 

```
curl -N -H "Accept: text/event-stream" \ 
  -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>" \
  "https://api.customer.example/v1/stream?session=abc" -v
```

Response headers they captured (first 2 events then stall):
```
HTTP/1.1 200 OK
Content-Type: text/event-stream
Transfer-Encoding: chunked
Connection: keep-alive
Cache-Control: no-cache

(last bytes) 0

```

alex_support: They also attached nginx-ingress logs showing the client connection closed at ~60s with code "upstream prematurely closed connection".

chris_netops: Classic ALB default 60s idle + nginx proxy_buffering and upstreams not flushing. Two issues to check in parallel: (1) ALB idle timeout vs server heartbeat; (2) ensure nginx isn't buffering/throttling chunk flushes.

alex_dev: For Node SSE you must flush after each write. Example code we asked them to try:
```
res.writeHead(200, {'Content-Type':'text/event-stream','Cache-Control':'no-cache'});
res.write('data: hello\n\n');
res.flush(); // on express with compression disabled / using compression: { threshold: 0 }
```
Also recommended they send a low-volume heartbeat every 15s (a single newline or comment line) to keep ALB from idling. SSE heartbeat usual pattern: `:heartbeat\n\n`

jess_support-liaison: They've confirmed server is flushing. Next we asked them to share nginx config. They sent ingress snippet: 
```
proxy_buffering on;
proxy_read_timeout 60s;
proxy_send_timeout 60s;
```

marie_pm: proxy_read_timeout 60s + ALB 60s is a problem — they line up and both will tear the connection. Also proxy_buffering on can cause chunk coalescing and delayed flush until buffer full.

chris_netops: Suggested nginx changes we asked them to apply (testing in staging first):
```
proxy_buffering off;
proxy_cache off;
proxy_read_timeout 3600s;
proxy_send_timeout 3600s;
proxy_http_version 1.1;
proxy_set_header Connection "";
chunked_transfer_encoding on;  # ensure nginx doesn't buffer chunks
```

And on the ALB: increase idle timeout to 300s. ALB default is 60s, so keep it > longest expected heartbeat interval + margin.

alex_support: Also recommended to disable gzip for SSE paths (gzip off;) or restrict gzip types.

jess_support-liaison: They applied `proxy_buffering off` + `proxy_read_timeout 300s` and bumped ALB idle to 300s in staging. Repro before change: disconnect at 60s consistently. After change: no disconnect observed in a 15min run. Customer asked if this is safe to roll prod.

chris_netops: Sounds good. We should document risk: turning off buffering increases memory per connection and may affect ingress pod capacity. For high concurrency we recommended using a dedicated ingress class or scale workers and configure connection draining. Also ensure LB connection limits and pod affinity.

alex_dev: Another mitigation: implement a short heartbeat from our service layer (every 10-20s) so even if some network or LB trims idle sockets we keep them alive. This also helps client-side dedupe logic.

alex_support: FYI we advised the customer to add idempotency on last event side (server-side seq id) so duplicate final token on reconnect is ignored.

oncall-bot: NOTE: created ticket INF-4921 to track recommended defaults for SSE paths (nginx: proxy_buffering off, read/send timeouts >= 5m, gzip off; ALB idle >= 300s). Assigned to eng-infra.

marie_pm: Good. We'll add this to the runbook and surface as recommended ingress profile for streaming workloads.

jess_support-liaison: Customer just confirmed prod roll went smoothly: they applied nginx changes and ALB idle bump during a maintenance window, streams stable for ~2 hours with no truncated events. They said CPU on ingress pods rose slightly but within expected limits.

alex_support: Marking resolved. Root cause summary (for ticket): ALB 60s idle timeout + nginx proxy buffering/read-timeout caused abrupt connection close and partial chunk emission. Fix: disable proxy buffering on SSE route, increase read/send timeouts, ensure chunked flushes and optional heartbeat bytes; align ALB idle timeout > heartbeat interval.

chris_netops: I'll add sizing notes to the infra ticket (memory per SSE connection, suggestions for horizontal autoscale).

alex_support: Closing thread — leaving ticket link INF-4921 in case PM/infra need follow-up. :white_check_mark:
